data.body: CHECKPOINT: Implementation complete. Created 3 files: (1) tests/scratch/test-receipt-parse.sh — 6 behavioral tests (29 assertions), confirmed RED before impl, GREEN after; (2) plugins/dso/scripts/receipt-parse.sh — validates exactly 3 fields (ticket_id, key, byte_count), emits RECEIPT_PARSE_ERROR to stderr with site/sub_agent/reason/byte_count on any violation, prints 'ticket_id key' to stdout on success; (3) plugins/dso/docs/contracts/scratch-receipt-contract.md — documents the receipt-only contract, RECEIPT_PARSE_ERROR semantics, and all error reason codes. All ACs satisfied. Not committed per task rules.
